definition.name: Active Tickets
definition.sql: SELECT id, ticket_number, title, status, priority, assignee_id, resolution_due_at, resolved_at, sla_policy_id, sla_breached, sla_warned, sla_calculation_status, sla_unresolved_reason FROM service_ticket WHERE is_active = true

definition.name: Inactive Tickets
definition.sql: SELECT id, ticket_number, title, status, priority, assignee_id, resolution_due_at, resolved_at, sla_policy_id, sla_breached, sla_warned, sla_calculation_status, sla_unresolved_reason FROM service_ticket WHERE is_active = false

definition.name: Queue Claim-To-Resolve, Minutes (Last 30 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT work_queue_ref AS queue_ref, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - claimed_at)) / 60.0) AS value FROM service_ticket WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND work_queue_ref IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

definition.name: SLA Attainment % (Last 30 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_breached IS NOT TRUE))::float8 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS value FROM service_ticket WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL AND (sla_calculation_status IS NULL OR sla_calculation_status <> 'unresolved') AND status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

definition.name: SLA Breaches By Queue And Priority
definition.sql: SELECT queue_id, priority, COUNT(*) AS breach_count FROM service_ticket WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND sla_breached = true GROUP BY queue_id, priority

target.query: SLA Breaches By Queue And Priority

definition.name: SLA Mean Time To Resolve, Minutes (Last 30 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 60.0) AS value FROM service_ticket WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
